# agentspend

> Track and cap AI agent API spend, and sync agent config/state across environments.
> A free local-first CLI — no server, no account, all data stays in `~/.agentspend`.

agentspend is a CLI with two tools for people running AI agents: `spend` records
API cost per provider/project, reports totals, and can fail a CI job when a
budget is exceeded; `sync` saves and restores named snapshots of agent
config/state files so you can move them between machines or environments.

# Source: package.json, src/cli.ts
# npm package: agentspend-cli (bin command: agentspend)

## What agentspend solves

- No visibility into what an agent's API calls actually cost — `spend track` + `spend report` gives a running total by provider and project.
- Budgets get blown silently — `spend budget <amount>` sets a cap; `spend budget` (no argument) exits non-zero when over, so it can gate CI.
- Agent config/memory drifts between machines — `sync save`/`sync load` snapshots a file under a named profile you can restore anywhere.

## Quick start
```bash
npm install -g agentspend-cli
agentspend spend track --provider openai --cost 0.42 --project myagent
agentspend spend report
agentspend spend budget 10.00
agentspend sync save myagent ./agent-config.json
agentspend sync load myagent ./restored-config.json
```
